name: Instamart Account Management
promise: In stock for the impulse basket on Swiggy Instamart, week after week.
intro: gaa-tha runs Swiggy Instamart account management for brands in India as a monthly operation: dark-store availability and fill rate tracked by city, purchase orders forecast and chased, catalogue and thumbnails maintained, pricing and promotions planned to margin, Instamart ads run to a target ROAS, ratings monitored, settlements reconciled and one monthly review across every city.

glance.bestFor: Snacks and beverages, ready-to-eat, dairy and bakery, beauty and personal care, household brands already live on Instamart
glance.timeline: Audit and setup in 1–2 weeks, then monthly
glance.model: Monthly management retainer; ad spend and platform charges paid directly to Swiggy

whatIs: Instamart account management is the ongoing operation of a brand's account on Swiggy Instamart after go-live: keeping SKUs in stock across dark stores, forecasting and coordinating purchase orders, maintaining catalogue content, planning pricing and promotions, running Instamart ads, monitoring ratings and reconciling settlements against what was supplied. Instamart demand spikes around meals, evenings, weekends and cricket and festival days, so availability planning has to account for those peaks rather than a flat weekly average.

At gaa-tha a named account manager owns the Instamart account. We track availability and fill rate by city and dark store, keep the PO cycle moving with your warehouse ahead of peak days, plan promotions around Swiggy's sale events and festive periods, and run ads only for SKUs and cities with stock to sell. The month ends with a review that puts sales, availability, ads, ratings and reconciled settlements side by side.
included: Weekly dark-store availability and fill-rate tracking by city, with out-of-stock alerts before peak days
Purchase-order forecasting, follow-up, dispatch coordination and receipt confirmation
Catalogue upkeep: titles with pack size, thumbnails, secondary images, attributes and combo or new SKU additions
Pricing and promotion planning to margin, including Swiggy sale events, festive campaigns and basket-builder offers
Instamart ads management — sponsored listings on search and category, and banner placements — to a target ROAS
Ratings and customer-feedback monitoring with product, packaging and delivery issues routed to the right owner
Settlement reconciliation: PO versus goods receipt, short receipts, damages, debit notes and ad invoices
Compliance checks on labelling, MRP, barcodes and shelf-life rules
Monthly review report covering sales, availability, POs, ads, promotions, ratings and reconciliation

steps.title: Audit and baseline
steps.text: We review listings, availability by city, PO history, ad performance and settlements, then agree the numbers the account is run against.

steps.title: Availability and PO rhythm

steps.title: Content and pricing

steps.title: Ads and visibility

deliverables: Weekly availability and fill-rate tracker by city and dark store
Purchase-order log with forecast, raise, dispatch and receipt dates
Maintained Instamart catalogue with current thumbnails and attributes
Promotion calendar and Instamart ads campaign structure
Monthly reconciliation statement with disputes and claims status
pricing: Monthly management retainer scoped to SKU count, cities and ad activity; Instamart ad spend and platform charges are paid by you directly to Swiggy.

faq.q: How do you manage availability and fill rate on Instamart?
faq.a: We check availability at dark-store level every week, flag SKUs that are out of stock or low in any city, and measure fill rate as quantity received against quantity ordered on each PO. Because Instamart demand peaks on evenings, weekends and event days, we forecast against those peaks rather than a flat average, and fix fill rate at your warehouse with packaging and dispatch discipline.

faq.q: How do purchase orders work on Instamart?
faq.a: Swiggy raises POs to its city warehouses based on demand and stock on hand, and the brand dispatches within the PO window. We forecast expected POs from sell-through, chase late ones, coordinate quantities and packaging with your team, track dispatch and receipt, and log short receipts or rejections for dispute.

faq.q: Do you maintain the catalogue and content?
faq.a: Yes. Titles with pack size, thumbnails, secondary images, attributes and descriptions are kept current, combos and new pack variants added, and listings rechecked after Instamart template changes. Thumbnails are produced in-house to stand out in a fast scroll.

faq.q: How do you plan pricing and promotions on Instamart?
faq.a: To margin first. We model the discount, Swiggy's share and the expected uplift before committing to a sale event, festive campaign or basket-builder offer, and keep pricing aligned across Blinkit, Zepto and your own store so no channel undercuts another.

Yes. Instamart offers sponsored listings on search and category pages and banner placements, and we run them by SKU and city against a target ROAS, weighted towards the hours and days when your category sells. Ads are paused in any city where the SKU is out of stock.

faq.q: How do you manage ratings on Instamart?
faq.a: Ratings and feedback are monitored weekly, product complaints separated from packaging and delivery issues, and each routed to the right owner. Recurring themes are reported monthly so pack, label or formulation changes can be made before they hurt sell-through.

Matching Swiggy's settlements to POs, goods receipt notes, short receipts, damages, returns, debit notes and ad or marketing invoices. Discrepancies are raised within the dispute window and tracked to closure so your books reflect what was actually supplied and sold.

faq.q: What is in the monthly review?
faq.a: Sales and units by city and SKU, availability and fill rate, PO status, catalogue changes, promotions and their margin impact, ad spend and ROAS, ratings trends and the reconciliation summary, followed by decisions on SKUs, cities and budget for the next month.
